confidence_rationale: Canonical, high-quality psychophysics + bounded-accumulation model directly demonstrating that an ALREADY-INITIATED action is revised/reversed by post-decisional evidence still in the processing pipeline. Maps tightly onto the 592f reach axis (release of an already-committed action on continued degraded decisiveness). Mapping fidelity high; transfer risk moderate (perceptual-decision reach task vs REE commitment latch, but the structural primitive -- post-commit evidence can abort -- is exactly the gap).
failure_signatures: The reversal is graded and evidence-driven (bounded accumulation continues post-decision), NOT a one-shot threshold flag -- a Schmitt-style K-consecutive-ticks-below-floor release at the latch would discard the continued-accumulation dynamics this paper shows are the mechanism.

Changes of mind improve accuracy when the initial decision was erroneous but can also wrongly reverse a correct decision; a maintenance-time release driven by transient low decisiveness risks premature abort of a correct-but-hard commitment.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Subjects deciding about noisy motion by reaching reverse their initial choice mid-movement on some trials, with no new external information; a bounded-accumulation model in which evidence still in the processing pipeline at the moment of commitment continues to accumulate and can cross a second bound that reverses or reaffirms the initial decision explains both the frequency of changes of mind and their dependence on task difficulty and initial accuracy.
mapping.ree_translation: Biological commitment is NOT locked irreversibly at the moment of action initiation: continued internal evidence/decisiveness (the REE R-c score_margin axis) can release/revise an already-committed action online. This directly evidences that MECH-090's beta-gate latch SHOULD have a maintenance-time release coupling on degraded within-tick decisiveness -- the 592f gap is a real architectural incompleteness, not a mis-routed expectation. It supports autopsy option (a) (an R-c-level release coupling) but reframes its trigger as graded continued-accumulation, not a one-shot flag.
mapping.mapping_caveat: Resulaj measures perceptual-decision reaches over ~hundreds of ms with a single post-decision bound; REE's commitment latch operates over E3 ticks across a multi-step motor program. The primitive (post-commit evidence reverses the action) transfers; the exact bound geometry and timescale do not. This paper evidences that maintenance-time readiness-driven release exists, NOT the specific REE implementation.
mapping.source_context: Human psychophysics, random-dot motion discrimination with reaching responses; computational bounded-accumulation (drift-diffusion-style) model.

confidence_components.notes: Nature, heavily replicated, foundational. Mapping_fidelity weighted high because the structural claim (post-commit evidence can reverse an initiated action) IS the 592f gap. Transfer_risk from perceptual-reach to REE multi-tick commitment kept at 0.35.
